identity_policy.git_blob_sha1: SHA1 of blob + space + decimal byte length + NUL + unmodified body; not a plain-file SHA1
identity_policy.md5: Published annex payload digest from authenticated Git pointer
identity_policy.sha256: Every original file SHA256 measured after exact size and published Git-content/annex-MD5 authentication; all131 required at runtime.
identity_policy.s3_version_ids: Not captured; content pin is exact published size and MD5; never infer immutable null version or ETag digest

licenses.templateflow: Captured original LICENSE and description retained for parent review; no redistribution authority inferred
